about: The master flashcard deck for Mexico (docs/flashcards.md → Next; pilot, Josh 2026-10-28): one card per syllabus word, built once and shared by every learner. word + article as said, the English sense taught, and what the picture shows. Pictures are tall 2:3 lotería cards made by scripts/build-flashcard-deck.mjs. Pilot: 60 picturable nouns from units a1-01 to a1-07; alcohol left out. Not served by the app yet.

voice.name: Alejandro
